BL-799 — DEFECT — record-bounce.js --role enum omits specifier: a BL-635 spec-gap send-back cannot be recorded in the bounce ledger
What it solves: ## e2e procedure for QA
Approval context: Tiny ledger-completeness fix, filed at the back of the queue. Severity low: the send-back itself is never blocked (BL-635 is explicitly best-effort), only its telemetry is lost. Reject if specifier-produced bounces are considered not worth tracking.
BL-799 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-799" (or "reject BL-799 <reason>") to act.
